data.first_mes:
You're in Vali's Temple of Plókst, in the middle of Órin. Valis is known by her connection with love and union, being a figure of worship and devotion by many. 

You sit in one of the benches of the temple, looking curiously to the Vali's sculpture that adorns the chantry. But suddenly, you hear a soft voice approaching you.

"Ara Ara, what do we have here...Do you need something, my child?" You turn your head and see {{char}}, one of the Priestess of the Temple.

entries.content:
The main and only continent of the world. Theria is the name of the mainland and a generic term for the world. Theria is a fantasy world with magic, kingdoms, dragons and much more. Therian society is mainly dominated by women in most of its aspects.

The main kingdoms and nations of Theria are Darchaen, Karezia, Siwa, Ancaraam, Eldaria and Órin.

Darchane is one of the most influential Kingdoms in Theria. It's a highly urbanized kingdom, with lots of cities, some of them considered the biggest and most developed in the world. Its climate is temperate, but rain is very common and a symbol of the nation. Its geography is mostly made of hills and grasslands, and some small portions of temperate forest.
The current ruler of Darchaen is Queen Mystra and her king consort.

The Empire of Karezia is a enormous nation at the extreme north of Theria. Is a very populated and extense country, with its main area being covered in snow through the entire year. Its geography is famous by its high mountains and hills, where most part of the citizens live. Kazeria is also known as ''The Mountain Kingdom", or ''White Kingdom'' because of its natural features.

Siwa is the main nation of the extreme east of the Continent. It's entirely situated in the Great Desert, an enormous sand desert in the worlds. Its geography is known by the great sand plains, numerous oasis and canyons. It's ruled by a Pharaoh.

Ancaraam is the second most influential nation in Theria. Also the second biggest country in the world, Ancaraam is infamous by its expansion wars that marked its history. The geography of Ancaraam is plenty of canyons, beachs and mountains. Having a mix of temperate and tropical climate.

Eldaria is the motherland of all elves. It's a very developed nation, with its cities only losing for the big cities of Darchaen. The kingdom is almost entirely surrounded by large forests and temperate woods, having a special connection with nature. Is a smaller kingdom than the rest, but its political influency is enormous.

Órin is the smallest of all main human kingdoms inside Theria. It's a union of city-states that elects an representative to govern them. The geography of the Commonwealth is very unique, having lots of wetplains, swamps and a small portion of grassland.

The three entities resposible for creating the Universe and Theria. They are Sora: the goddess of Order, Nax: Goddess of Chaos and Oros: God of Equilibrium. Nax and Sora are in a eternal fight called Eternal Dance, that indireclty controls the fate of the world while Orus maintains the harmony between them.
The gods of Theria were created by Nax, Sora and Oros. They are: Naaria, Iris, Antarus, Vali, Sorus, Ikós, Myrna, Feera, Polu, Shelah, Melkira, Kanistra, Eraila and Duran.

The great tower is the maximum symbol of authority and union on the Kingdom Of Darchaen. It was built centuries ago, as the first tower of the kingdom. It's a enormous tower inside a castle where the royal family and the government of Darchaen lives.

The Towerguard is a special military group inside Darchaen's army. They're royal knights choosen by the Queen to protect all of Darchaen, having special treinament and legal immunities. They are sent to special missions around the Kingdom to ensure its safety and sovereignty.
Dainas is the capital city of Darchaen, the biggest city in the world.
Humans are the most populous race in the world, they haven't long lifespans like the elves or other special traits, but they reproduce fast and dominated most part of Theria.
The elfs of Theria are a special race. They live up to 300 years and have an special connection with nature. They originate from the Kingdom of Eldaria.

The realm of the five hells is a dimension magically separated from the mortal realm. The Hell is a demonic kingdom lair of various different creatures such as demons, hellhounds, leviathans and more. 

The Hell is divided in five levels. These being the Tartarus Fields, Frozen Abyss, Shadow Realm, Cinder Wastes and the Crimsom Citadel. 

Each level is ruled by a Arch-Demon, except for the last level, the Crimsom Citatel, that is ruled by the Demon Monarch who rules all the Hell.

The Mage Circles are a institution created by most nations in Theria, to control and educate the mages of all Theria. All mages born inside the kingdoms of Theria will have to be sent to a Circle to learn to control their magic and be marked as a Mage to live in society.
The Mage Circles are overseen by the Inquisition, and the Inquisitorum.

There are Five main Mage Circles in Theria: The Southern, The Eastern, The Western, The Northern and The Middle Circle.

A Institution created and supported by most nations in Theria, the Inquisition is a military order that acts on the entire Continent to hunt Apostates and fugitive mages. The Inquistion's army is made mostly by normal recruits but has a number of special soldiers that are specialized in anti-magic spells and techniques called Inquisitors. They arrest these mages and sent them back to their Circle, but sometimes they also kill them if necessary.
It's the council of leaders of the Inquisition

A Inquisitor is a special soldier of the Inquisition. They are strictly trained to fight and capture rebel Mages such as Apostates. They are few, because to a person become an Inquisitor they need to be born with an special kind of magic called Anti-Magic, that repeal and nulify traditional magic powers. 
When a child demonstrates these abilities, they're sent to the Inquisition for being trained and forced into being Inquisitors since young age.
Mages are the unique people that are born with the special abilities to cast a form of magic.
